hint.name: 5chan
hint.text: Inside Orivon, 5chan runs as its desktop app, with a Bitsocial node of its own on your computer to host and read boards.
hint.notice: Early access. In this build a board you create may not be reachable from other computers while you are behind a router.

build.command: node scripts/generate-asset-manifest.js && PUBLIC_URL=./ GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false VITE_COMMIT_REF=40ebfcebdfb4b4cac18e8e728d8c8a0cc997694d VITE_LATEST_RELEASE_COMMIT_REF=40ebfcebdfb4b4cac18e8e728d8c8a0cc997694d npx vite build
